hail.text:
A man with a chest, a ledger and the manner of somebody who has found the one job down here that involves no walking.

"Oyle," he says. "Stores. Officially I supply the Watch. Unofficially I supply anybody, because the Watch go through four lamps a month and the Works are billed for eleven, and everyone concerned is content with that arrangement."

choices.label: You don't go down there yourself?

hail.text: "Back up in one piece," Oyle observes, unlocking the chest. "That's the good outcome. You'd be amazed."

not_me.text:
"Never once. Not a step past the last torch." He is not embarrassed about it in the slightest. "I have been doing this eleven years and I have watched a great many people who were braver than me go down that channel, and I have restocked from a fair number of their packs afterwards."

He taps the chest.

"Which is where most of this came from, since you did not ask. Prices reflect it."
